title: Customer Compliance Request Harmonizer & Evidence Gap Planner for Hosting Modes
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a wide variety of security and compliance artifacts (SOC2 questionnaires, ISO checklists, HIPAA data flow questions, GDPR/DPA clauses and vendor questionnaires). Reviews are manually routed to Security/Legal/Infra, leading to inconsistent SLAs, duplicated evidence requests, and unclear remediation plans for different hosting modes (hosted API, Dedicated, Private/VPC).

Objective: Deliver a triage workflow and lightweight automation that: 1) canonicalizes incoming requests, 2) maps each question to an evidence artifact or a remediation task, 3) routes work to the correct owner (Security, Legal, Platform, Solutions), and 4) produces an "Evidence Gap Plan" showing required artifacts and estimated effort per hosting mode. The feature should reduce mean time to triage and produce standardized response bundles for customers and for internal audits.

Scope: MVP will handle SOC2/ISO questionnaire items, standard GDPR/DPA residency questions, basic HIPAA checklist flags, and common vendor questionnaire templates (SIGLite/DBIR-style). It will not change legal wording or sign agreements; it will instead produce a prioritized list of follow-ups and evidence. The system must be extensible to add new questionnaire templates and map custom customer items.

Success metrics: reduce manual triage time by 60% for incoming requests, achieve evidence mapping precision >= 90% on curated prompt sets, and produce a first-pass Evidence Gap Plan in under 48 hours for P1 customer asks.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming questionnaire parsed and categorized (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor) with >=90% classification accuracy on test set
Each question mapped to a recommended evidence artifact OR a remediation action with confidence score
Automatic routing rule exists: security items -> Security queue, legal precedent items -> Legal queue, infra/hosting items -> Platform/Infra
Evidence Gap Plan generated as a downloadable bundle (PDF + index) containing links to existing assets and explicit missing-evidence checklist
MVP supports per-hosting-mode impact matrix: hosted / dedicated / private with required controls and estimated effort
Time-to-first-triage for P1 tickets <= 48 hours and for P2 <= 5 business days
Integration points documented: Confluence evidence registry, evidence-bundler repo, and Support ticket link generation
